rows.note: This is the all-purpose everyday choice for someone who is resolute and committed to a goal.

example.english: They are purposeful and will finish the project no matter how hard it gets.
example.traditional: 佢哋好有決心，就算再辛苦都會完成個計劃。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 hou2 jau5 kyut3 sam1 zau6 syun3 zoi3 san1 fu2 dou1 wui5 jyun4 sing4 go3 gai3 waak6

rows.note: Use this when describing an action deliberately done for a reason, rather than something merely meaningful or goal-oriented.

example.english: I made a purposeful decision to buy this book because I want to learn Cantonese.
example.traditional: 我特登買呢本書嘅，因為想學好廣東話。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dak6 dang1 maai5 ne1 bun2 syu1 ge3 jan1 wai6 soeng2 hok6 hou2 gwong2 dung1 waa2

rows.note: Use this for something purposeful in the sense of being meaningful, worthwhile, or giving life meaning.

example.english: Volunteering makes me feel that life is purposeful.
example.traditional: 做義工令我覺得人生好有意義。
example.jyutping: zou6 ji6 gung1 ling6 ngo5 gok3 dak1 jan4 saang1 hou2 jau5 ji3 ji6
